title: Nondivisibility fingerprint probability
statement: Let $M\ge12$ be an integer and let $y$ be a nonzero integer with $|y|\le 2^{5M2^M}$. Choose a Boolean string $r$ uniformly from strings of length $2M$, and interpret it as the nonnegative integer whose bits, read from least significant to most significant, have place values $1,2,4,\ldots$. The probability that this integer plus one does not divide $y$ is at least $1/(4M)$.
